messages.author: cad36eead1754edc
messages.subject: RNA-Seq
parts:
You can now analyze your RNA-Seq data with CellNet!

See our RNA-Seq CellNet Github page: https://github.com/pcahan1/CellNet for the code and brief instructions. See our Nature Protocols paper for detailed instructions, including how to train a CellNet platform from scratch: https://www.nature.com/nprot/journal/v12/n5/full/nprot.2017.022.html

A new web application for analyzing RNA-Seq starting with fastq files is coming soon.
